suppress.notes: CVE-2025-48924 affects commons-lang 2.0 through 2.6, inherited through interlok-json/json-lib. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-j288-q9x7-2f5v There is no patched Commons Lang 2.x release. The fix is in commons-lang3 3.18.0 or later, which changes the artifact, major version and package names and cannot replace json-lib's dependency. Accepted risk: untrusted class names reaching ClassUtils.getClass can exhaust the stack and cause denial of service. Revisit when interlok-json replaces its legacy JSON-lib dependency.

CVE-2024-47855 affects net.sf.json-lib:json-lib through 2.4, inherited through interlok-json. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-wwcp-26wc-3fxm No patched net.sf.json-lib 2.x release exists. The maintained org.kordamp.json:json-lib-core fork fixes this in 3.1.0, requiring an artifact and major-version migration outside this dependency-only change. Accepted risk: malicious JSON containing an unbalanced comment can exhaust parser resources and cause denial of service. Revisit when interlok-json migrates to a maintained JSON parser.
